Package io.github.jabrena.juno.annotations

package io.github.jabrena.juno.annotations
Compile-time-only annotations an entry-point class uses to configure Juno's compilation, read directly from the class file rather than at runtime.
  • @Board selects the target Arduino board, e.g. @Board(ArduinoUnoR4WiFi.class). A class with no @Board annotation targets the UNO R4 WiFi by default. ArduinoBoard is the sealed type token @Board accepts, currently implemented only by ArduinoUnoR4WiFi; the linker resolves the selection into a io.github.jabrena.juno.board.Board compilation target.
  • @Watchdog enables the RA4M1's hardware watchdog timer, rebooting the board if generated code ever stops kicking it (including on a juno_panic()) instead of hanging forever.
